description: The can function gives false for a call of a function that fails
notes: The README says can gives false for an expression that produces errors, but the spec's call rules don't say that a function that fails makes its call an error (see native/functions/function-error-is-eval-error). hashicorp/hcl reports the function's error as an error in the call (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), so can gives false (can in ext/tryfunc/tryfunc.go).
